hero.description: We blend the mathematics of code with the elegance of design. A bespoke digital tuxedo, tailored for your brand.

manifesto.paragraph1: I am Ahmet Yiğit Canlı. I am 21 years old and have been challenging mediocrity in the digital world with my passion for software for the last 6 years. For me, every line of code should work perfectly like the gears of a clock and look as aesthetic as a painting.
manifesto.paragraph2: To date, I have produced Fullstack solutions for global clients, built digital authentication systems for luxury bags worth millions, and developed AI-powered automations. While continuing my MIS education at UTAA, I actively hold the Head of IT role at a company and add value to brands through my freelance projects.
manifesto.paragraph3: On-time delivery and unwavering care are my signatures. I am here to transform complex problems into simple and effective works of art using the 'Less is more' philosophy.

faq.title: Frequently Asked.
faq.subtitle: We've compiled the answers to your questions in the simplest form.

items.question: How does the process work, when do I get delivery?
items.answer: We don't tire you with complicated processes. First we discuss your goals, then we prepare a custom design for your approval. After approval, we complete the coding and launch your site within an average of 2-4 weeks.

items.question: Will my site rank high on Google?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our sites don't just look stylish; they're coded with Google's favorite infrastructure (SEO-friendly, ultra-fast, and mobile-friendly). This puts you 1-0 ahead of your competitors.

items.question: Can I update the site myself later?
items.answer: Yes. If you wish, we integrate a very easy-to-use management panel to your site. You can update your texts, images, or products like sharing an Instagram post without any coding knowledge.

items.question: How is pricing determined?
items.answer: Every business has different needs. Instead of template sites, we make a 'digital suit' tailored just for you. We offer the fairest and most transparent quote based on the project scope.

items.question: Do you provide support after the site is finished?
items.answer: Working with us isn't a one-time job, it's a long-term partnership. We're always by your side for technical support, maintenance, and updates even after the site goes live.

peonyArticle.title: Peony Collective: Where Digital Aesthetics Meets Craftsmanship
peonyArticle.excerpt: Explore how we pushed the boundaries of digital craftsmanship in the Peony Collective project, blending elegance, luxury, and functionality.
peonyArticle.content:
Luxury in the digital realm is not merely about sleek visual presentation; it is a refined emotion felt through every interaction. In creating Peony Collective, our objective was to fuse classic aesthetic sensibilities with the capabilities of cutting-edge web technologies.

Meticulous attention to detail in every pixel, timeless typographic harmony, and fluid transitions capture the brand's authentic identity. Beyond offering a visual feast, we ensured that user experience and performance remain uncompromised at the highest standards.

At VR0CKS, we regard digital craftsmanship as a true passion. Peony Collective stands as a tangible manifestation of this passion and our 'Less is More' philosophy.

minimalism.title: Minimalism: Stopping Digital Noise
minimalism.excerpt: Every unnecessary detail is a second stolen from the user's focus. Explore the power of 'Less is more' philosophy in modern web design.
minimalism.content:
In the digital world, 'more' does not always mean 'better'. On the contrary, every unnecessary animation, every bright color, and every complex menu is a thief stolen from the user's main purpose.

Minimalism is not just about leaving space, it is about making what is most important shine. As VR0CKS, we use the 'power of silence' in our projects. We design interfaces that do not tire the user's eyes, do not cloud their mind, and reach them where they want to go in the most elegant way.

A website can be a work of art, but we do not allow this art to kill functionality. Digital craftsmanship is about finding the perfect balance between aesthetics and speed.

nextjs.title: Why Next.js? Beyond Performance
nextjs.excerpt: Not just speed, but SEO and developer experience. Why do we always choose the most modern infrastructure in VR0CKS projects?
nextjs.content:
In the modern web world, seconds are worth gold. A 1-second delay in opening a site means a potential customer turning away at the door. That's why we don't compromise on our infrastructure at VR0CKS.

Next.js provides us not only with speed, but also with excellent visibility for search engines (SEO). With server-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation (SSG) technologies, your site becomes as fluid as a mobile application and as organized as a library.

Software is the skeleton of your brand. We build this skeleton from the strongest and most modern steel.

luxury.title: Luxury and Digital: Building Trust
luxury.excerpt: A deep look into the digital authentication of million-dollar products and user experience design in the luxury segment.
luxury.content:
Luxury is not just a high price tag; it is a promise of trust and perfection. In the world of million-dollar bags or rare works of art, the digital experience must also carry this weight.

In the million-dollar product authentication projects I've carried out in the past, I've seen that the moment the digital interface doesn't give confidence, all prestige is shaken. In the systems we design for luxury brands, we build every detail from micro-interactions to security protocols with this 'silent luxury' understanding.

Building trust in the digital world is a craft beyond pixels. We blend this craft with the rules of luxury.
